local util_cargo = require('Module:CargoUtil')

local operators = util_cargo.query{
	tables = 'Operators=O, Locales=Loc',
	join = 'O.Operator = Loc.Entity',
	fields = 'Operator=link, Loc.Value=name, Rarity=star, Class=class, Element=element, Weapon=weapon, Faction=faction, Gender=gender, Icon=iconImage, Banner=bannerImage, Portrait=portraitImage',
	where = 'Lang="en" AND Param="name"',
}
local characters = util_cargo.query{
	tables = 'Characters=C, Locales=Loc',
	join = 'C.Chara = Loc.Entity',
	fields = 'C.Chara=link, Loc.Value=name, Faction=faction',
	where = 'Lang="en" AND Param="name"',
}

local data = {}

for i, row in ipairs(operators) do
	row.star = tonumber(row.star)
	local key = row.name
	local gender = row.gender
	if key == "Endministrator" then
		key = string.format("%s (%s)", key, gender:lower())
	end
	data[key] = row
end
-- alias
data["Endministrator"] = data["Endministrator (female)"] -- default as female Endmin.

-- add all Characters that are not already in the list (e.g. Operators)
for i, row in ipairs(characters) do
	if not data[row.name] then
		data[row.name] = row
	end
end

return data
